structured_output.title: New certificate annotation copy option available in v1.18.0
structured_output.content: cert-manager v1.18.0 adds `--extra-certificate-annotations` controller flag to copy annotation keys from Ingress or Gateway resources to Certificate objects. Your environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate CRD installed and manifest apiVersions include Ingress/Gateway capable resources. After upgrade, this new optional flag becomes available. Verify whether you use Ingress or Gateway resources with annotations you want propagated to Certificate objects, and check the release notes for flag usage and any breaking changes in v1.18.0.
